what: THE ONE DECLARATION of what lives under content/ (R1041). validate:content schema-checks AUTHORED paths and fails on any top-level entry declared nowhere; scan:vocab skips only STAFF_RECORDS. Both read this file, so the two scanners cannot drift apart (R42). Adding a path to either list is a decision with a reason, printed with its file count on every run.

records.exports: generated reviewer packs; output of the repo (gitignored)
records.review-returns: returned decisions files, checked at the point of use
records.pilot-review: pilot item batches, gated by scripts/lib/pilot-review.ts on every write (R47)
records.agent-review: agent drafting and review working files (R1031-R1040); what lands is gated in the DB by check:db-content and check:every-string-field
records.case-faces: provenance records for case doorplates landed by landCaseFace; the face itself is gated at landing and in the DB
records.notices: approved notice text with its authority; landed by the notice path
records.standing-losses: records of content lost and not recovered
records.wordlists: plain word lists read by checks
records.maths-noncomputable-keys.json: declared non-numeric maths keys, read by verify:solutions (R1040)
records.union-appropriateness-fixture.json: test fixture for the appropriateness union
